desk:
**BLUF:** The community is focused on a Russian strike in Kharkiv, a reported attack on Riyadh’s airport, and Trump’s surprise energy-ceasefire claim that Zelensky called “news to me.” The single most important development is the Saudi airport incident amid rising regional tensions.

## MAIN THREADS

### Kharkiv strike
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2109337386677141878) posted video and details of a Russian bombing of a residential neighborhood and grocery store, killing three and injuring nine including two children.
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2109337672367866109) shared a Telegram link confirming the same incident.

### Riyadh airport attack
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2109328573899386986) reported the Saudi General Authority of Civil Aviation statement confirming an attack on King Khalid International Airport with injuries and ongoing damage assessment.

### Energy ceasefire announcement
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2109287936575340947) noted Trump’s Truth Social post declaring an immediate energy ceasefire agreed by both sides.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2109295987101737306) quoted Barak Ravid reporting Zelensky’s statement that the announcement was “news to him” but Ukraine would accept it if Russia agrees.

### Gulf of Oman / Strait of Hormuz incidents
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2109278580609864120) reported NASA FIRMS thermal anomaly off Oman and UKMTO notice of a tanker struck by unknown projectile causing fire.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2109275459112546339) added UKMTO report of another vessel hit in the Strait of Hormuz with damage but no crew injuries.

### Poland security alert
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2109221289546371305) cited Reuters on an emergency meeting after reports of an assassination plot against PM Tusk and Defense Minister Kosiniak-Kamysz.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2109296272494493741) assessed both sides have incentives to ignore any energy ceasefire (unconfirmed analyst comment).  
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2109278580609864120) linked the Oman thermal anomaly to the UKMTO tanker report (unconfirmed).  
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2109221289546371305) reported the Poland plot via Reuters (unconfirmed).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts will watch whether the Riyadh attack triggers further Saudi or US responses and if the energy-ceasefire claim produces any verifiable pause in strikes. Maritime incidents in the Gulf of Oman remain a focus for escalation signals.
